The 13.5-mile course with approximately 2,000 feet of vertical gain offers a perimeter tour of the park with breathtaking views of Horsetooth Reservoir, Fort Collins, the Great Plains, and Rocky Mountain peaks. The course features 12 miles of dirt singletrack and 1 mile of dirt road, with terrain ranging from technical to non-technical hard-pack trails. location.name: Cassel, CA

description: A laid-back, high-fun trail adventure featuring a 4.8-mile looped course through beautiful private property near Baum Lake. Participants can run, walk, crawl, or compete in the burro race. Events include 48-Hour Challenge (Oct 22-24), 24-Hour Challenge (Oct 23-24), and 12-Hour/4.8-Mile options (Oct 24). Course offers 50/50 mix of single-track and dirt service road with 370 ft elevation gain per loop, scenic views of Baum Lake, and night running under starry skies. Includes aid station with food, beverages, and broth bar. Race swag, medals, belt buckles for 100+ mile finishers, and cash prizes for most miles.
